title: Meta removes ToS language that suggested it could scrape websites "associated with" business accounts, saying it applied only to "ads and business products" (Terrence O'Brien/The Verge)
summary: Terrence O'Brien / The Verge: Meta removes ToS language that suggested it could scrape websites “associated with” business accounts, saying it applied only to “ads and business products” — Language that experts say allowed the scraping of news sites to train its AI has been removed from Meta's terms.
contentText:
Terrence O'Brien / The Verge :

Meta removes ToS language that suggested it could scrape websites “associated with” business accounts, saying it applied only to “ads and business products”   —  Language that experts say allowed the scraping of news sites to train its AI has been removed from Meta's terms.
